verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API offering edit, search, compaction and classification tools. Its evidence never documents a way to define or schedule automations that run on their own. The standby service tier is described as suited to batch and background workloads, but it is only a discounted priority tier for API calls the user sends, not a product-run automation. Reflex training jobs and canary traffic trials are likewise one-off API operations, not recurring autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
